claims.claim:
Spoken / sighted Falmouth off Fal-
mouth (May 8)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bavaria (Ham), Taube, Hamburg May 6, with
mdse and 855 passengers, to Kunhardt & Co. May 8, off Fal-
mouth, saw steamship America (Brem), bound E; 13th, lat
48 10, lon 29 30, ship John Bright, from Liverpool, for New
York; 15th, lat 46 30[?], lon 39, ship Eliza Caroline (Br), bound
W; 21st, lat 40 20, lon 69, steamship City of Limerick, bound
E; same day, lat 40 30, lon 70, bark Warren White (of Salem),
bound N.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 233 miles of Sandy Hook (29th 10 a. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br.), Tibbits, Liverpool April 14, Queenstown
16th, with mdse. and 733 pass. to John G. Dale. April 17th, 185 miles
W. of Fastnet, passed steamship Louisiana. 24th, lat. 43 50, lon. 45 08[?],
Br. bark Gooyer[?] Castle, bound W. 27th, lat. 41 33, lon. 61, 7:30 p. m.,
a steamer bound E., showing one blue light and one rocket. 29th, 10
a. m., 233[?] miles of Sandy Hook, passed steamships America, City of
Boston, and Teutonia; 1 p. m., steamship Hibernia, bound E.
